standard_prerequisites: Chapter lemma-separable-goes-up (delivered card L48370): separability goes up in towers, so beta separable over k is separable over k(alpha)
Chapter lemma-separably-generated-separable (source lemma): an extension finitely generated by separable elements is a separable extension
Definition in this chapter: an extension is separable when every one of its elements is separable over the base
core_obligations: For alpha, beta separable over k, beta is separable over k(alpha) by separable-goes-up
Applying the separably-generated-separable lemma with n = 2, alpha_1 = alpha, alpha_2 = beta, the extension k(alpha, beta)/k is separable

Every element of k(alpha, beta) - in particular alpha + beta, alpha - beta, alpha beta, alpha/beta, and every element of k - is separable over k, so the separable elements are closed under the field operations and contain k: a subextension
proof_roadmap: Push separability up the two-step tower
Read the closure properties off the separability of k(alpha, beta)/k
